fusions.name: Linked Runners
fusions.desc: Sends a runner vine into one enemy for 7 damage. It then links on to 2 more enemies within 3 tiles, each taking 60% of that damage. Holds 4 charges; a kill restores one.

fusions.name: Grapnel Tendril
fusions.desc: Hooks one enemy with a tendril and hauls you up to 7 tiles to it, dealing 13 damage. The target is left [Hindered] for 4 seconds and 15% easier to wound for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Reeling Creeper
fusions.desc: Knots a creeper at a spot ahead of you for 5 seconds, dragging every enemy near it inward. Enemies it strikes move 20% slower for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Bound and Fed
fusions.desc: When you inflict a condition on an enemy, you regain 2 health a second for 3 seconds. Once every 6 seconds.
